thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-p99-detector triggered for service=redwood-stream region=eu-west-1. p99 latency jumped from ~180ms -> ~1.2s over last 3m. paging @oncall-sre :rotating_light:

elliot: seeing the spike on the stream dashboard. p95 also increased but p99 is terrible. streaming websocket clients reporting chunk gaps of 800-1200ms.

rachel: confirmed. tail stalls align with a deployment that toggled the new slo-aware-autoscaler policy ~4m ago. deploy id: autoscale-rollout-2026-03-15-10:05.

oncall-sre: I'm on call and looking at ASG and pod events now. ping me if you see customer impact.

infra-bot: Event stream: 10:05:12 autoscaler policy applied on eu-west-1, targetUtilization changed 60%->35%, scaleDownStabilization 30s->5s.

meera: that's suspicious. shorter stabilization + lower target -> aggressive downscaling. streaming workloads don't tolerate cold starts well.

elliot: quick checks:
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"streaming\"}[2m])) by (le))
```
current: ~1.18s at 6212345780; p95 ~400ms. concurrent inflight requests rose 3x during scale-down window.

oncall-sre: pod churn logs: several model-worker pods terminated between 6212345700-6212345750 due to downscale. New pods warmup ~30-45s. while warming, requests queued leading to tail latencies.

rachel: customer-success: two enterprise customers reported degraded streaming responsiveness and one complaint escalated. no increased error rate, but SLA p99 is breached for the last 6m.

meera: recommend immediate mitigations: 1) pause autoscaler policy for eu-west-1, 2) set minReplicas to safe floor for streaming service, 3) enable traffic steering to eu-central-1 for new sessions.

oncall-sre: executing mitigation now: patching HPA to set minReplicas=12 and disabling slo-aware policy flag. running kubectl patch to HPA streaming-models-eu:
```
kubectl patch hpa streaming-models-eu -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":12}}'
```

(ops-bot): HPA patch applied. minReplicas=12. slo-aware-autoscaler flag disabled.

elliot: watching dashboards. p99 down to ~480ms within 60s on the cluster that received no new scale-downs. overall p99 trending to ~360ms after traffic steering.

infra-bot: traffic-steering rule applied: new session affinity set to route 30% of eu-west-1 traffic to eu-central-1 as fallback.

meera: we should still capture the autoscaler decision logs and scaling traces; this looks like a bad heuristic for streaming workloads. opening incident page.

rachel: incident declared (no title per channel rules). incident page: https://incidents.redwood.internal/inc/6212345678 created by rachel. Notifying account teams.

cust_success: initial customer notif sent for impacted tenants. template: "We observed degraded streaming response times in eu-west-1; mitigation applied and rollback planned; will follow up with RCA."

oncall-sre: rolling back autoscaler policy across eu clusters to previous config (targetUtilization 60%, scaleDownStabilization 30s). will monitor for churn.

elliot: post-rollback metrics: p99 dropped to ~220-370ms across region by 6212345885. tail stalls largely resolved.

meera: root-cause hypothesis: slo-aware-autoscaler uses p95 as an input but had a bug where it interpreted bursty short-term p95 drops as a signal to downscale aggressively. For streaming endpoints, brief p95 drops can coincide with load bursts; the short stabilization caused oscillation and cold starts.

rachel: filing follow-up ticket INF-9002 "autoscaler: stabilization and heuristics unsuitable for streaming workloads" assigned to eng-infra.

oncall-sre: actions captured: 1) immediate rollback and minReplica floor applied 2) traffic steering to fallback region 3) customer notifications sent 4) monitoring watch for 30m.

elliot: proposed long-term fixes: add workload-class tag to autoscaler so streaming services use conservative scaling; add warmup hook for model-worker pods; add alert for high pod churn (>3 pods/min) with correlation to p99 increases.

meera: also add runbook step: if buffer/queue length > threshold during scale events, abort scale-down. create INF-9003 for runbook updates.

rachel: timeline notes: 10:05 autoscaler policy rollout; 10:06 p99 alert; 10:07-10:09 investigation; 10:09 mitigation applied (minReplicas + disable flag); 10:11 traffic steering started; 10:13 global rollback complete; 10:22 p99 stable below SLA.

oncall-sre: closing live mitigation watch at 6212345922  moving incident to monitoring state. oncall remains assigned for 30m.

cust_success: will send follow-up customer update with timeline and next steps once RCA draft ready.

rachel: thanks team  good quick coordination. we'll assemble an RCA and postmortem and link infra tickets. :white_check_mark:
